text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "They also welcome the diplomatic corps – all foreign ambassadors to Switzerland – at a New Year’s reception in the Federal Palace.", "gist": "Swiss hosts a New Year's reception for all foreign ambassadors in the Federal Palace."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Since the 1990s it has been usual for the President of the Swiss Confederation to go on official visits abroad.", "gist": "Swiss Confederation President has routinely made official foreign visits since the 1990s."}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "The president is also responsible for fostering relations with the cantons.", "gist": "Swiss president must foster relations with the cantons."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "National Day addresses", "gist": "National Day addresses are mentioned as a separate category."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "The difference between ‘state’ and ‘presidential’ visits", "gist": "A topic explaining the distinction between state and presidential visits is discussed."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "A Swiss president never pays a state visit, but can still be received for a state visit by a host country.", "gist": "Swiss president does not initiate state visits but can be hosted for one by another country."}, {"type": "question", "quote": "How is that possible?", "gist": "Question asking for explanation of how Swiss president can be hosted for a state visit without initiating it."}]}
